The '''Denendre Valley''' was a valley on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was bordered by the [[Rhaler's Bastion]] mountain range on one side and by the [[Nomad Mountains|Thaos Mountains]] and the [[Vella plains]] on the other side. A river flew through the Denendre valley until it reached the [[Riverlands]] near the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Denendre Valley is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
